issueDefinitions.scope: Japanese grammar problems observable in the quoted learner text, including particle choice, predicate form, politeness form, or word order.
issueDefinitions.explanationRequirement: Name the Japanese grammar problem visible in the quote and give a corrected Japanese version of the quoted span.

issueDefinitions.scope: Japanese phrasing in the quoted learner text that is grammatical but awkward, overly direct, or unsuitable for the practice situation and register.
issueDefinitions.explanationRequirement: Explain why the quoted Japanese phrasing is unnatural for this situation and give a more natural Japanese alternative for the quoted span.

issueDefinitions.scope: Ways the quoted learner text fails to request repetition, acknowledge the repeated information, or otherwise answer the Japanese step prompt.
issueDefinitions.explanationRequirement: State which required part of the Japanese step prompt or communication objective the quoted text does not fulfill and what is missing.
